_contract: Frozen BEFORE any C3 behavioural result exists. THREE arms and nine probes, per the 2026-09-28 supplement, which supersedes the six-probe design.

claim_boundary._primary_is_the_operator_isolation: this contrast owns the formal scientific claim about causal-KL itself, with model-forward batching held at the incumbent's own B1/original-order protocol so it is not a second variable.
secondary_contrasts: causal-B3 - causal-B1  (the numerical protocol's downstream effect)
causal-B3 - incumbent B  (the practical optimized treatment)
claim_boundary._not_three_promotion_hypotheses: only the primary is an operator-promotion test. The other two are prespecified secondary/practical contrasts and may not be substituted for it after seeing results.
claim_boundary._no_post_hoc_b1_b3_selection: the B1/B3 deployment choice is left to the post-C3 review. No non-inferiority boundary is preregistered here, because inventing a tolerance after seeing the data is the failure this clause exists to prevent, and none is needed for an automatic decision.

A_incumbent.name: B (incumbent)
A_incumbent._therefore: rebuilt through the frozen verified path from the same parent, gated on the digest above. Searched 2026-09-28: absent from the relay and from the out-of-tree store.

B_causal_b1.name: causal-KL B1
B_causal_b1._role: the clean operator-isolation causal arm: causal-KL importance against activation importance, without batching as an extra variable.

C_causal_b3.name: causal-KL B3 optimized
C_causal_b3._protocol_provenance: packing-v2 counterbalanced screen: pooled 492.553 s against B1's 586.509 s, fastest of four and lower-memory than B4.

arms._operator_semantics: one-shot for both causal arms: every query head scored independently against the INTACT pre-ATTENTION parent. No delete-and-rescore, no joint subset search.
arms._only_intended_difference: the initialization. Same teacher, corpus, ordering rule, optimizer, runtime contract, battery, scoring, seeds and bootstrap across all three arms.

shared_parent._explicit_not_default: bound to B1 explicitly. Repository defaults are MEASURED to change structural decisions, so no formal result may depend on whatever DEFAULT_MICRO_BATCH_SIZE happens to be.

seeds._mechanical: no human choice; reproducible from the base digest alone

_disjoint_from._checked: none of the four C3 seeds appears anywhere in logs/ or configs/ as of 2026-09-28

recovery._fresh: every probe fresh; no new reuse semantics are invented
recovery._matrix: 3 arms x the SAME 3 seeds; no arm elimination, no successive halving, all nine complete before interpretation

estimand.primary: Delta = causal-KL-B3 treatment - incumbent B, on correct_overall
estimand.aggregation: prompt mean of the mean over the three fixed paired seeds
estimand._seeds_are_blocks: three FIXED experimental blocks, not an IID sample from a seed population

decision_rule._secondary_contrasts_use: the same paired prompt-level machinery -- Delta, LCB/UCB, three seed deltas, usable deltas, McNemar counts, per-domain breakdowns -- reported completely, but they do not redefine the primary verdict.

guardrails._plus: the existing catastrophic capability and protocol-validity vetoes

terminal_outcomes.GO: promote attention.causal_kl_v1 + B3/length_sorted_v1 as the ATTENTION treatment for this path. C4 becomes scientifically eligible but is NOT authorized.

_initializations_are_seed_independent: THREE initialization states are constructed and verified ONCE each, then fanned out into three recovery seeds. The causal scorers are NOT rerun per seed.

interpretation_matrix.A: primary GO and B3 not materially worse than B1 -> causal-KL supported; B3 adoption considered on its downstream and engineering evidence
interpretation_matrix.B: primary GO and B3 materially degrades vs B1 -> causal-KL supported, B3 NOT automatically promoted; the numerically safer B1 path stands
interpretation_matrix.C: primary not GO but B3-vs-B looks better -> NOT proof that causal-KL alone is superior. Report as 'causal-KL + B3 protocol differs from causal-B1' and return for review. No post-hoc relabelling.
interpretation_matrix.D: neither causal arm improves over B -> B remains incumbent
